name: Jimmy Styks Orca Stand-Up Paddleboard
description: Just entering the sport of stand-up paddling? If so, Jimmy Stykss Orca Stand-Up Paddleboard is just what you need. Hard, high-density polyethylene (HDPE) bottom surface and signature Jimmy Styks 50/50 deck construction consisting of two layers of 6-oz. epoxy glass (one full deck, one partial deck) wrapped in graphic-printed IPXE soft foam create one durable, impact-resistant board. Three molded-in stringers deliver additional strength and rigidity. Comes with a Jimmy Styks standard aluminum paddle, stabilizer fin, fin hardware and 10-ft. coil leash. 132L x 31W x 4.75D. Wt: 24 lbs. Wt. capacity: 270 lbs. Type: Stand-Up Paddleboards.
